d3-array.min.js and d3-geo.min.js are the official UMD builds, copied
unmodified from npm via jsdelivr on 2026-09-19:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-array@3.2.4/dist/d3-array.min.js
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-geo@3.1.1/dist/d3-geo.min.js

d3-geo depends on d3-array, so both load (in that order) as classic scripts
before the page's module code. Both are ISC, copyright Mike Bostock.

Consumers: js/globe.js (projections, path rendering, graticule, spherical
hit testing via geoContains, centroids and areas for labels and draw order).
Nothing else from D3 ships with this site; there is no DOM, scale, or zoom
module here, the gestures are hand-written pointer handlers.

Do not edit these files. To upgrade, replace both together and update the
versions above.
